notes: Colour: panorama exposure varies a lot; sampled medians are cream-yellow (#faeec5, clipped) where sunlit and grey-brown (#6b6252, #6c6251) in shade/overcast, hue 38-43 deg. Wall set to a warmer, darker buff #c4975f with pale stone #e0d0a8 bands; the brown-orange read of the integrator could not be confirmed on the Leidseplein front (it matches the 1927 canal wing, which stays dark brown). Window axes counted from ref-se-winter.jpg. Tower cap is pale stone with clock faces. Temporary cafe awnings are not modelled. Upper storeys of the SE front stand 1.2 m behind the ring line in the 3DBAG shell, windows sit on that plane. Gable silhouettes remain the 3DBAG roof planes.
